scope: Synthetic OpenAI Responses SSE, SQLite migration guards, public owner-scoped records, Workbench and Android home UI source checks
implementation: Direct cloud LLM execution streams bounded progress internally and persists only monotonic output-byte observations; response text is not copied into live-meter metadata.

The visible provisional estimate uses the signed quote's maximum input-token bound and observed output UTF-8 bytes divided by three, rounds up under the approved quote cap, and is explicitly marked as an estimate rather than provider meter or final charge.

The full provider-reported token usage from response.completed is the only source for final itemized calculated usage. An unresolved or over-cap result retains its budget reservation and remains unreconciled.
Owner-facing API, device home, Workbench and Android task surfaces distinguish provisional estimate from reserved maximum and final provider usage.

The standalone API integration harness also fails at local listener startup with the same EPERM before assertions; production build was independently successful.
